Pendidikan (Penggal Institusi Pendidikan Tahun 2015) 2014.

Pemakaian

2. Peraturan-Peraturan ini terpakai bagi kehadiran di institusi pendidikan

bagi tahun 2015.

Tempoh penggal institusi pendidikan

3. Tempoh penggal bagi institusi pendidikan bagi tahun 2015 adalah sebagaimana

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

EDUCATION ACT 1996

EDUCATION (TERMS OF EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS YEAR 2015)

REGULATIONS 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 130(2)(b) of the Education Act 1996

[Act 550], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Education (Terms of Educational

Institutions Year 2015) Regulations 2014.

Application

2. These Regulations shall apply to attendance at educational institutions for the

year 2015.

Duration of terms of educational institutions

3. The duration of terms of educational institutions for the year 2015 shall be

as specified in the Schedule.
